heading: Criminal penalties

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Any person who violates section 5363 shall be fined under title 18, imprisoned for not more than 5 years, or both.

tree.heading: Permanent Injunction.—
tree.text: Upon conviction of a person under this section, the court may enter a permanent injunction enjoining such person from placing, receiving, or otherwise making bets or wagers or sending, receiving, or inviting information assisting in the placing of bets or wagers.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 109–347, title VIII, § 802(a), Oct. 13, 2006, 120 Stat. 1961.)
